title: ISO-NE .Z.RHODEISLAND: day-ahead minus real-time by hour
subtitle: Mean spread for each local hour, 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-24, USD/MWh
source_line: Source: ISO-NE via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), tables isone_dam_zone_prices, isone_rtm_zone_prices; data retrieved to 2026-10-25.
citations: ISO New England (ISO-NE). Day-Ahead Energy Market Hourly LMPs. Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `isone_dam_zone_prices`, ERW commit ba88d85d6094.
ISO New England (ISO-NE). Real-Time Energy Market Five-Minute LMPs. Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `isone_rtm_zone_prices`, ERW commit ba88d85d6094.
facts: ISO-NE .Z.RHODEISLAND, 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-24: the mean day-ahead minus real-time spread was highest in the hour starting 18:00 local, 5.66 USD/MWh, and lowest in the hour starting 01:00, -3.02 USD/MWh.
Mean spread over all hours, 2026-09-04 to 2026-09-10: 1.26 USD/MWh.
